$comment: Example native Claude policy for a policy-controlled Enso workspace. Lives at <policy_dir>/claude/settings.json, chmod 600, OUTSIDE the workspace. Verified against Claude Code 2.1.226 by the security harness: blocks reads of ~/.ssh, ~/.enso, and out-of-workspace paths (incl. via Bash subprocesses), blocks the enso CLI, confines network to api.anthropic.com, and strips secret env vars — while allowing normal work inside the workspace. Tune to your needs; Enso does not grade this file.
